# Cold Mystery

> > Cold Mystery explores ancient religious traditions, sacred cosmologies, and spiritual practices across Polynesian, Roman, Celtic, and Etruscan cultures.

The site examines ancestral spirits, divine manifestations, ritual purification, and cosmological frameworks from Māori, Fijian, Cook Islands, Roman, and Irish mythologies. Each article investigates the sacred boundaries, lineage systems, and spiritual energies that shaped ancient worldviews.

## Key Topics

- Māori cosmology
- Polynesian mythology
- Fijian ancestral spirits
- Ancient Roman religion
- Cook Islands mythology
- Atua (divine manifestations)
- Sacred traditions and boundaries
- Ritual purification and expiation
- Irish mythology
- Vari-ma-te-takere
- Tāne
- Ancestral guardian spirits
- Religious guilt and atonement
- Cosmological origins
- Celtic and Etruscan deities

## Māori Cosmology and Deities

- [Papa-tū-ā-nuku: The Earth Mother at the Foundation of Polynesian Mythology](https://www.coldmystery.com/2026/01/papa-tu-nuku-earth-mother-at-foundation.html): Māori Earth Mother Papa-tū-ā-nuku and Rangi-nui creation mythology
- [Hine-nui-te-pō: The Māori Goddess of Death and the Night](https://www.coldmystery.com/2026/02/hine-nui-te-po-maori-goddess-of-death.html): Māori death goddess Hine-nui-te-pō ruling night and Te Reinga afterlife
- [Arohirohi: Illusion and Mirage in Māori Tradition](https://www.coldmystery.com/2026/01/arohirohi-illusion-and-mirage-in-maori.html): Māori concept of shifting illusion and mirage within atua cosmology
- [Ngā Aroha o te Atua: The Spiritual Energy of the Loving Deity](https://www.coldmystery.com/2026/02/nga-aroha-o-te-atua-spiritual-energy-of.html): Māori spiritual energy of divine love and aroha within atua belief

## Polynesian Divine Manifestations

- [Atua-roa: The All-Encompassing Manifestation of Divine Power](https://www.coldmystery.com/2026/01/atua-roa-all-encompassing-manifestation.html): Polynesian divine manifestation Atua-roa with Tangaroa and Tāne
- [Te Aka-ia-roa: The long root from which beings and realms arise](https://www.coldmystery.com/2026/02/te-aka-ia-roa-long-root-from-which.html): Cook Islands cosmic root of emergence tied to Vari-ma-te-takere
- [Vaerua – The Material Spirits of Cook Islands Mythology](https://www.coldmystery.com/2026/02/vaerua-material-spirits-of-cook-islands.html): Cook Islands tangible spirits Vaerua in Polynesian cosmology
- [Teipe in Mangaia: a lineage-bound atua tied to descent and fertility](https://www.coldmystery.com/2026/02/teipe-in-mangaia-lineage-bound-atua.html): Mangaian lineage deity Teipe tied to fertility and Vari-ma-te-takere

## Roman Sacred Traditions and Rituals

- [Hostia Piacularis: The Purifying Sacrifice for Unseen Guilt](https://www.coldmystery.com/2026/01/hostia-piacularis-purifying-sacrifice.html): Roman purification ritual for accidental offenses guided by pontifices
- [Arval Brothers: Rome's Secret Guardians of Fertile Land](https://www.coldmystery.com/2026/01/arval-brothers-romes-secret-guardians.html): Fratres Arvales secret priesthood preserving Rome's agricultural fertility
- [Scalae Gemoniae: The Roman Steps Where Political Legitimacy Ended](https://www.coldmystery.com/2026/01/scalae-gemoniae-roman-steps-where.html): Capitoline steps where Rome publicly stripped enemies of political power
- [Terminus: The Roman God of Boundaries, Land Marks, and Sacred Borders](https://www.coldmystery.com/2025/12/terminus-roman-god-of-boundaries-land.html): Roman deity Terminus guarding land markers and sacred border violations
